pr_title: add skip ci support for pull request title
pr_body:
Extends #28075 to support [skip ci] inside PR titles.

Close #29265

issue_context.title: skip ci for Pull Request
issue_context.body:
### Feature Description

Similar to the already existing skip ci flag fo commits. Skipping CI for the complete pull Request. For example a doc pull request which does not need CI

### Screenshots

_No response_
comments: you can do it by https://github.com/dorny/paths-filter

`paths-filter` is great and the ideal solution, yeah.

But for unsophisticated action configs, it might still be useful to accept the `[skip ci]` from the PR title.

review_comments: Because the test function to create a PR uses master as default branch, and it doesn't work well with main :laughing:
We could also rename every occurrence of master in the tests to main in a later PR, would be appropriate as it's our default branch nowadays
Yeah I agree, sounds like a good refactor to do to avoid such noisy changes in the future.
